Applying "Trading Around a Core" Principles to the META Trade:

I mentioned how one has to pay attention to sentiment.

When META first corrected from 790 to around 700, I saw popular X accounts start buying the dip early (which is how they ended up with averages close to 700). Given I know they have no discipline, I waited as it was too early. Started doing homework. "want to be one of the last ones to buy the dip principle"

Once it got to sub-610, I started nibbling and then got some in the 580s. The stock then rebounded to 740 earlier this year and I took additional shares off (trading around a core).

The next few months were pretty choppy with the stock pulling back to 520-540 several times, which is where I accumulated to bring my cost average to the mid-500s. Called for 740 as my target.

Trimmed small into the high 600s and I had identified 740 as a technical and fundamental target to where I get back to core positioning.

Trading around a core.

as an observant cat, have always thought different cities had a different vibe, psychological, emotional state to them, and its somehow more to do with humans involved, and less to do with just the superficial differences like different buildings or congestion

so cat started reading about it from a more scientific pov, it appears one can indeed register other's faces and their emotional state from a distance, just from peripheral vision, and be measurably impacted by them

now that it has affected one, what if one turn the block and impact another!

and so if a city has enough of few of these major emotional forces, then does that really pushes the overall vibe of a city toward a specific direction? and could this be manipulated ? is this why city have parks? 💀

some cool studies:
10.1371/journal.pone.0125804 
10.1371/journal.pone.0021584
10.1371/journal.pone.0008207
